Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese ʻi he toafa ʻo Sainai, ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻi he ʻuluaki ʻaho ʻo hono ua ʻoe māhina, ʻi hono ua taʻu ʻo ʻenau haʻu mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite, ʻo pehē,

And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
“Mou lau ʻae kakai kotoa pē ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo fakatatau mo e fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo lau kotoa pē ʻi honau hingoa, ʻae kakai tangata kotoa pē taki taha;
Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
Mei honau taʻu ʻe uofulu tupu, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau ʻi ʻIsileli: ko koe mo ʻElone ke mo lau ʻakinautolu ʻi heʻenau ngaahi matatau.
From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
Pea ʻe fakataha mo kimoua ha tangata ʻe tokotaha mei he faʻahinga kotoa pē; ko ia taki taha ʻoku ʻeiki ʻi he fale ʻo ʻene ngaahi tamai.”
And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
Pea ko e ngaahi hingoa eni ʻoe kau tangata ʻe tuʻu mo kimoua; ko ʻIlisua, ko e foha ʻo Setiua ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Lupeni:
And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Ko Selumieli, ko e foha ʻo Sulisatai ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Simione.
Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Ko Nasoni, ko e foha ʻo ʻAminitapi ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Siuta.
Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Ko Netanili, ko e foha ʻo Sua ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo ʻIsaka.
Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
Ko ʻIliapi, ko e foha ʻo Heloni ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Sepuloni.
Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
‌ʻI he fānau ʻa Siosefa: ko ʻIlisama, ko e foha ʻo ʻAmihuti ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo ʻIfalemi; ko Kāmelieli, ko e foha ʻo Petasuli ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Manase:
Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Ko ʻEpitani, ko e foha ʻo Kitione ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Penisimani.
Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Ko ʻEhiesa, ko e foha ʻo ʻAmisatai ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Tani.
Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Ko Pakieli, ko e foha ʻo ʻOkilani ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo ʻAseli.
Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Ko ʻIliasafi, ko e foha ʻo Teuili ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Kata.
Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
Ko Heila, ko e foha ʻo ʻEnani ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Nafitali.
Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
Ko kinautolu ni naʻa nau ongoongo lahi ʻi he kakai, ko e houʻeiki ʻi he ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ko e ʻeiki ʻoe ngaahi toko afe ʻi ʻIsileli.
These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
Pea naʻe ʻave ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone ʻae kau tangata ni kuo fakahā honau hingoa:
And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

Pea naʻa nau fakataha ʻae kakai kotoa pē ʻi he ʻuluaki ʻaho ʻo hono ua ʻoe māhina, pea naʻa nau fakahā honau hokohoko ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau mo e lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa taki taha, mei hono uofulu tupu ʻoe taʻu ʻo fai hake.

And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
ʻO hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, naʻe pehē ʻa ʻene lau ʻakinautolu ʻi he toafa ʻo Sainai.
As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

Pea ko e fānau ʻa Lupeni, ko e ʻuluaki foha ʻo ʻIsileli, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa taki taha, ʻae tangata kotoa pē, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Lupeni, ko e toko fā mano mo e toko ono afe ma nimangeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Simione, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻakinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa taki taha, ʻae tangata kotoa pē mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Simione, ko e toko nima mano mo e toko hiva afe ma tolungeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Kata, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Kata, ko e toko fā mano mo e toko nima afe mo e toko onongeau ma nimangofulu.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

Ko e fānau ʻa Siuta, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Siuta ko e toko fitu mano mo e toko fā afe ma onongeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa ʻIsaka, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu, naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo ʻIsaka ko e toko nima mano mo e toko fā afe ma fāngeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Sepuloni, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Sepuloni ko e toko nima mano mo e toko fitu afe ma fāngeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Siosefa, ʻio, ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIfalemi ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻa ʻIfalemi, ko e toko fā mano ma toko nimangeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Manase, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Manase, ko e toko tolu mano, mo e toko ua afe ma uangeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Penisimani, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Penisimani, ko e toko tolu mano, mo e toko nima afe ma fāngeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Tani, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Tani, ko e toko ono mano, mo e toko ua afe ma fitungeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa ʻAseli, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu, ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Pea ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo ʻAseli, ko e toko fā mano, mo e toko taha afe ma nimangeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

Ko e fānau ʻa Nafitali, ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe ngaahi hingoa, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau;

Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻio, ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Nafitali, ko e toko nima mano, mo e toko tolu afe ma fāngeau.
Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
Ko kinautolu eni naʻe lau, ʻaia naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone, mo e houʻeiki ʻo ʻIsileli, ko e kau tangata ʻe toko hongofulu ma toko ua: naʻe taki taha tuʻu maʻae fale ʻo ʻene ngaahi tamai.
These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

Naʻe pehē ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, mei hono taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe mālohi ke ʻalu atu ke tau ʻi ʻIsileli;
So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
‌ʻIo, ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ko e toko ono kilu, mo e toko tolu afe, mo e toko nimangeau ma nimangofulu.
Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
Ka naʻe ʻikai lau ʻiate kinautolu ʻae kau Livai ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.
But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
He kuo folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
“ʻE ʻikai te ke lau ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Livai, pea ʻoua naʻa ke lau ʻakinautolu fakataha mo e fānau ʻa ʻIsileli:
Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

Ka ke fakanofo ʻae kau Livai ke pule ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakamoʻoni, pea mo e ngaahi nāunau kotoa pē ʻi ai, pea mo e ngaahi meʻa kotoa pē ʻi ai, pea tenau fua ʻae fale fehikitaki, pea mo hono ngaahi nāunau kotoa pē; pea tenau ngāue ki ai, ʻo nofo takatakai ki he fale fehikitaki.

But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
Pea ʻoka ʻalu atu ʻae fale fehikitaki, ʻe vete hifo ia ʻe he kau Livai; pea ʻoka nofo ʻae fale fehikitaki, ʻe fokotuʻu ia ʻe he kau Livai: pea ko e muli ʻoku haʻu ke ofiki ai ʻe tāmateʻi ia.

And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
Pea ko e fānau ʻa ʻIsileli tenau fokotuʻu ʻa honau ngaahi fale fehikitaki, ʻae tangata taki taha ki hono ʻapitanga, pea mo e tangata taki taha ki hono fuka, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga.
And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

Ka ʻe nofo ʻae kau Livai ʻo takatakai ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakamoʻoni, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa ai ha houhau ki he fakataha ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli: pea ʻe tokanga ʻae kau Livai ki he tauhi ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakamoʻoni.”

But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
Pea naʻe fai ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻo fakatatau ki he meʻa kotoa pē kuo fekau mai ʻe Sihova kia Mōsese; naʻe pehē pe ʻenau fai.
And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, mo ʻElone, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
‌ʻE nofo ʻae tangata taki taha ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ki hono fakaʻilonga, ʻo fakataha mo e fuka ʻoe fale ʻo ʻenau tamai; pea tenau nofo mamaʻo ʻo folifoliaki ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

Pea ʻe nofo ʻi he potu hahake ʻo hangatonu ki he hopoʻangalaʻā, ʻakinautolu ʻoe fakaʻilonga ʻoe ʻapitanga ʻo Siuta ʻi heʻenau ngaahi matatau: pea ko Nasoni ko e foha ʻo ʻAminitapi ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Siuta.

And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
Pea ko ʻene kautau ʻaʻana, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko fitu mano, mo e toko fā afe ma onongeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
Pea ko kinautolu ʻe hokoʻo nofo mo ia ko e faʻahinga ʻo ʻIsaka, pea ko Netanili ko e foha ʻo Sua, ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsaka.
And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko nima mano, mo e toko fā afe ma fāngeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
Pea ʻe hoko ai ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Sepuloni, pea ko ʻIliapi, ko e foha ʻo Heloni ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Sepuloni.
Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
Pea ko ʻene kautau mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko nima mano, mo e toko fitu afe ma fāngeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
Pea ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi he ʻapitanga ʻo Siuta, ko e tokotaha kilu, mo e toko valu mano, mo e toko ono afe ma fāngeau, ʻi heʻenau ngaahi matatau. ʻE ʻalu muʻomuʻa atu ʻakinautolu ni.
All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
Pea ʻe tuʻu ʻi he feituʻu tonga ʻae fakaʻilonga ʻoe ʻapitanga ʻo Lupeni ʻo fakatatau ki heʻenau ngaahi matatau; pea ko ʻIlisua ko e foha ʻo Setiua ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Lupeni.
On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko fā mano, mo e toko ono afe ma nimangeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
Pea ko kinautolu ʻe hoko nofo mo ia, ko e faʻahinga ʻo Simione: pea ko Selumieli ko e foha ʻo Sulisatai ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Simione.
And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko nima mano, mo e toko hiva afe ma tolungeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
Pea ʻe hoko ai ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Kata pea ko ʻIliasafi ko e foha ʻo Teuili, ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he ngaahi foha ʻo Kata.
Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko fā mano, mo e toko nima afe mo e toko onongeau ma nimangofulu.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

Pea ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi he ʻapitanga ʻo Lupeni, ko e tokotaha kilu, mo e toko nima mano, mo e toko taha afe mo e toko fāngeau ma nimangofulu, ʻi heʻenau ngaahi matatau. Pea ʻe ʻalu atu ʻakinautolu ʻi hono ua ʻoe ʻotutangata.
All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.

Pea ʻe toki ʻalu atu ʻae fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, fakataha mo e ʻapitanga ʻoe kau Livai ʻi he lotolotonga ʻoe kau tau: ʻo hangē pe ko ʻenau nofo, ʻe pehē pe ʻi heʻenau fononga atu, ko e tangata taki taha ʻe ʻi hono potu ʻi honau fakaʻilonga.
Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
Pea ʻe tuʻu ʻi he potu lulunga ʻae fakaʻilonga ʻoe ʻapitanga ʻo ʻIfalemi, ʻo fakatatau ki heʻenau ngaahi matatau: pea ko ʻIlisama ko e foha ʻo ʻAmihuti, ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he ngaahi foha ʻo ʻIfalemi.
On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko fā mano mo e toko nimangeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
Pea ʻe hoko mo ia ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Manase: pea ko Kāmelieli ko e foha ʻo Petasuli, ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Manase.
And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko tolu mano mo e toko ua afe mo e uangeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
Pea ʻe hoko ai ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Penisimani: pea ko ʻEpitani ko e foha ʻo Kitione ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Penisimani.
Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, koe toko tolu mano mo e toko nima afe ma fāngeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

Pea ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi he ʻapitanga ʻo ʻIfalemi, ko e tokotaha kilu, mo e toko valu afe, mo e toko teau, ʻi honau ngaahi matatau. Pea ʻe ʻalu atu ʻakinautolu ʻi hono tolu ʻoe ʻotutangata.
All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
Pea ʻe tuʻu ʻi he potu tokelau ʻae fakaʻilonga ʻoe ʻapitanga ʻo Tani ʻi heʻenau ngaahi matatau: pea ko ʻEhiesa ko e foha ʻo ʻAmisatai ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Tani.
The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko tolu mano, mo e toko ua afe ma toko fitungeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
Pea ko kinautolu ʻoku hoko nofo mo ia ko e faʻahinga ʻo ʻAseli: pea ko Pakieli ko e foha ʻo ʻOkilani ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻAseli.
And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko fā mano, mo e toko taha afe ma nimangeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
Pea ʻe hoko ai ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Nafitali: pea ko Heila ko e foha ʻo ʻEnani ʻe ʻeikitau ia ʻi he fānau ʻa Nafitali.
Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
Pea ko ʻene kautau, mo kinautolu naʻe lau ai, ko e toko nima mano, mo e toko tolu afe ma fāngeau.
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
Pea ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi he ʻapitanga ʻo Tani, ko e tokotaha kilu, mo e toko nima mano, mo e toko fitu afe ma onongeau. Pea ʻe muimui ʻakinautolu mo ʻenau ngaahi fuka.
All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

Ko kinautolu ia naʻe lau ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai: ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi honau ngaahi ʻapitanga, ʻi honau ngaahi matatau, ko e toko ono kilu, mo e toko tolu afe, mo e toko nimangeau ma nimangofulu.

These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
Ka naʻe ʻikai lau ʻae kau Livai ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

Pea naʻe fai ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻo fakatatau ki he meʻa kotoa pē kuo fekau mai ʻe Sihova kia Mōsese: ko ia naʻa nau nofo ai ki honau ngaahi fakaʻilonga, pea naʻe pehē ʻenau fononga atu; taki taha ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo fakatatau ki he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.

And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
Pea ko eni foki ʻae ngaahi toʻutangata ʻo ʻElone mo Mōsese ʻi he ʻaho naʻe folofola ai ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese ʻi he moʻunga ko Sainai.
These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
Pea ko e hingoa eni ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo ʻElone; ko Natapi ko e ʻuluaki ia, mo ʻApiu, mo ʻEliesa, mo ʻItama.
And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Pea ko e hingoa ia ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo ʻElone naʻe fakanofo ko e kau taulaʻeiki, ʻakinautolu naʻa ne fakatapui ke ngāue ʻi he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki.
These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

Pea naʻe mate ʻa Natapi mo ʻApiu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ʻi heʻena ʻomi ʻae afi kehe ki he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻi he toafa ʻo Sainai, pea naʻe ʻikai haʻana fānau: pea ko ʻEliesa mo ʻItama naʻa na ngāue ʻi he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki ʻi he ʻao ʻo ʻElone ko ʻena tamai.

And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
“Ke ke fakaofi mai ʻae faʻahinga ʻo Livai, pea fakahā ʻakinautolu ʻi he ʻao ʻo ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki koeʻuhi kenau ngāue kiate ia.
Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
Pea tenau tokanga ki heʻene ngāue, mo e ngāue ʻae kakai kotoa pē, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ke fai ki he ngāue ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
Pea tenau tauhi ʻae ngaahi meʻa kotoa pē ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, mo e ngāue ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ke fai ki he ngāue ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
Pea te ke foaki ʻae kau Livai kia ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha: kuo foaki ʻakinautolu kotoa pē kiate ia mei he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.
And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
Pea te ke fakanofo ʻa ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha, pea tenau fai ʻenau ngāue fakataulaʻeiki: pea ko e muli ʻe haʻu ʻo ofi ʻe tāmateʻi ia.”
And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
“Pea ko au, vakai, Ko au kuo ʻomi ʻae kau Livai mei he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ke fetongi ʻaki ʻae ʻuluaki tama kotoa pē kuo ne toʻo ʻae manāva ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; ko ia ai, ʻe ʻoʻoku ʻae kau Livai;
And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

Koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻoʻoku ʻae ʻuluaki tama kotoa pē; he ko e ʻaho ne u taaʻi ai ʻae ʻuluaki fānau ʻi he fonua ko ʻIsipite, ne u fakatapui ai kiate au ʻae ʻuluaki tama ʻi ʻIsileli, ʻae tangata mo e manu; Ko au ko Sihova ʻe ʻoʻoku ʻakinautolu.”

Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese ʻi he toafa ʻo Sainai, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
Ke ke lau ʻae fānau ʻa Livai ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, mo honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻae kakai tangata kotoa pē mei hono taha māhina, ke ke lau fakaʻaufuli ʻakinautolu.
Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
Pea naʻe lau ʻakinautolu ʻe Mōsese ʻo fakatatau ki he folofola ʻa Sihova, pea hangē ko e fekau kiate ia.
And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
Pea ko e hingoa eni ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Livai; ko Kesoni, mo Kohate, mo Melali.
And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
Pea ko e ngaahi hingoa eni ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ko Lipinai, mo Simi.
And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ko ʻAmilami, mo ʻIsa, mo Hepeloni, mo ʻUsili.
And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Melali ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ko Mali, mo Musi. Pea ko e ngaahi fānau ʻoe kau Livai ʻakinautolu ni, ʻo fakatatau ki he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai.
And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
Pea naʻe ʻia Kesoni ʻae faʻahinga ʻoe kau Lipinai, mo e faʻahinga ʻoe kau Simi; pea ko e ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe kau Kesoni ʻakinautolu ni.
Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
Ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe kakai tangata mei hono taha māhina ʻo fai hake, ʻio, ʻakinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ko e toko fitu afe ma toko nimangeau.
Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
Pea ʻe nofo kituʻa ʻi he fale fehikitaki ki he potu lulunga ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe kau Kesoni.
The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
Pea ko ʻIliasafi ko e foha ʻo Laeli, ko e ʻeiki ia ʻoe fale ʻoe tamai ʻae kau Kesoni.
And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
Pea ko e ngāue ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ko e faletapu, pea mo e fale fehikitaki, mo hono pulonga, pea mo e puipui ʻoe matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.

And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
Pea mo e ngaahi puipui ʻoe lotoʻā, pea mo e puipui ʻoe matapā ʻoe lotoʻā, ʻaia ʻoku ofi ki he fale fehikitaki, pea ʻoku takatakai ʻae feilaulauʻanga, pea mo e ngaahi maea ki he ngāue kotoa pē ʻi ai.
And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

Pea naʻe ʻia Kohate ʻae faʻahinga ʻoe kau ʻAmilami, pea mo e faʻahinga ʻoe kau ʻIsa, pea mo e faʻahinga ʻoe kau Hepeloni, pea mo e faʻahinga ʻoe kau ʻUsili, pea ko e ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe kau Kohate ʻakinautolu ni.
And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
Ko e lau ʻoe kakai tangata kotoa pē mei hono taha māhina ʻo fai hake, ko e toko valu afe ma toko onongeau, kuo nau fai ki he ngāue ʻoe faletapu.
In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
Ko e ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate tenau nofo ʻi he potu tonga ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
Pea ko ʻElisefani ko e foha ʻo ʻUsili ko e ʻeiki ia ʻoe fale ʻoe tamai ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoe kau Kohate.
And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

Pea ko e meʻa kenau tauhi, ko e puha ʻoe fuakava, mo e palepale, mo e tuʻunga maama, mo e ngaahi feilaulauʻanga, mo e ngaahi ipu ʻoe faletapu ʻaia kuo nau ngāueʻaki, pea mo e puipui, pea mo e ngaahi meʻa kotoa pē ʻi ai.
And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
Pea ko ʻEliesa, ko e foha ʻo ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki ko e pule ia ʻoe houʻeiki ʻoe kau Livai, pea ʻe pule ia kiate kinautolu ʻoku fai ʻae ngāue ʻoe faletapu.
And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
Pea naʻe ʻia Melali ʻae faʻahinga ʻoe kau Mali, mo e faʻahinga ʻoe kau Musi: pea ko e ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo Melali ʻakinautolu ni.
Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
Pea ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻo fakatatau ki he lau ʻoe kakai tangata kotoa pē, mei hono taha māhina ʻo fai hake, ko e toko ono afe ma toko uangeau.
And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
Pea ko Suleli ko e foha ʻo ʻEpieli ko e ʻeiki ia ʻoe fale ʻoe tamai ʻae ngaahi faʻahinga ʻo Melali: ko kinautolu ni, ʻe nofo ʻi he potu tokelau ʻoe fale fehikitaki.
And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

Pea ʻoku ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Melali ʻae ngaahi laupapa ʻoe fale fehikitaki, mo hono ngaahi ʻakau fakamaʻu, mo hono ngaahi pou, mo hono ngaahi tuʻunga pou, pea mo hono ngaahi ipu kotoa pē, pea mo e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻi ai.

And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
Pea mo e ngaahi ʻotu pou ʻoe lotoʻā, pea mo honau ngaahi tuʻunga, mo honau ngaahi tutuki, mo honau ngaahi maea.
And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

Ka ko kinautolu ʻoku nofo ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fale fehikitaki ki he potu hahake, ʻio, ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai ʻi he potu hahake, ko Mōsese, mo ʻElone, mo hono ngaahi foha, ke tauhi ai ʻae ngāue ʻoe faletapu ki he ngāue ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; pea ko e muli ʻoku haʻu ʻo ofi ʻe tāmateʻi ia.

But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

Ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi he kau Livai, ʻaia naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone ʻi he fekau ʻa Sihova, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻae kakai tangata kotoa pē mei hono taha māhina ʻo fai hake, ko e toko ua mano ma toko ua afe.

All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
Pea naʻe pehē ʻe Sihova kia Mōsese, “Ke ke lau ʻae ʻuluaki tama tangata kotoa pē ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli mei hono taha māhina ʻo fai hake, pea ke lau honau hingoa.
And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

Pea ke ʻave ʻae kau Livai moʻoku, (Ko au ko Sihova) ke fetongi ʻaki ʻae ʻuluaki fānau ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; pea mo e fanga manu ʻae kau Livai, ke fetongi ʻaki ʻae ʻuluaki kotoa pē ʻoe fanga manu ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.”

And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
Pea naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese ʻae ʻuluaki tama kotoa pē ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kiate ia.
And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

Pea ko e ʻuluaki tama tangata kotoa pē ʻi he lau ʻa honau hingoa mei hono taha māhina ʻo fai hake, ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ko e toko ua mano, mo e toko ua afe, mo e toko uangeau, mo e toko fitungofulu ma toko tolu.
And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

“ʻAve ʻae kau Livai ke fetongi ʻaki ʻae ʻuluaki tama kotoa pē ʻi hē fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; pea mo e fanga manu ʻae kau Livai ke fetongi ʻaki ʻenau fanga manu pea ko e kau Livai ʻe ʻoʻoku ʻakinautolu: Ko au ko Sihova.
Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
Pea koeʻuhi ko kinautolu, ʻe huhuʻi ʻae toko uangeau mo e toko fitungofulu ma toko tolu ʻoe ʻuluaki tama ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻakinautolu kuo tokolahi hake ʻi he kau Livai;
And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
Ke ke ʻave ʻa esikeli ʻe nima maʻanautolu taki taha, ʻo fakatatau ki hesikeli ʻoe faletapu: (koesikeli ko e kela ʻe uofulu:)
Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
Pea te ke ʻatu ʻae paʻanga, ʻaia kuo huhuʻi ʻaki ʻakinautolu ʻoku toe, kia ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha.”
And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
Pea naʻe maʻu ʻe Mōsese ʻae paʻanga huhuʻi ʻokinautolu naʻe tokolahi hake ʻiate kinautolu naʻe huhuʻi ʻe he kau Livai:
And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
Naʻe maʻu ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi paʻanga mei he ʻuluaki fānau ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; ko esikeli ʻe afe ma tolungeau ma onongofulu ma nima, ʻo fakatatau mo esikeli ʻoe faletapu:
Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
Pea naʻe ʻatu ʻe Mōsese ʻae ngaahi paʻanga kuo huhuʻi ʻaki ʻakinautolu kia ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha, ʻo hangē ko e folofola ʻa Sihova, pea hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese mo ʻElone, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Mo lau ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate mei he ngaahi foha ʻo Livai, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻo fakatatau ki he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai,
Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
Mei he taʻu ʻe tolungofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻio, ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nimangofulu, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku ʻalu ki he tau, ke fai ʻae ngāue ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Pea ko e ngāue eni ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻi he ngaahi meʻa toputapu.
This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
Pea ʻoka hiki atu ʻae ʻapitanga, ʻe haʻu ʻa ʻElone, mo hono ngaahi foha, kenau vete hifo ʻae fakapulonga, ʻo ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae puha ʻoe fuakava:
And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
Pea ʻe tuku ki ai ʻae kiliʻi pasia ke ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia, pea ʻe ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae kofu lanumoana, pea ʻe ʻai ki ai hono ʻakau haʻamo.
And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

Pea ko e palepale ʻoe ma ʻoe ʻao tenau ʻuʻufi ʻaki ʻae kofu lanumoana, pea tuku ki ai ʻae ngaahi ipu, mo e ngaahi sēpuni, mo e ngaahi ipu louluo, pea mo e ngaahi tāpuni ke ʻufiʻufi ʻaki; pea ʻe tuku ki ai ʻae ma ʻoe ʻao:
And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
Pea tenau ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae kofu kulaʻahoʻaho, pea ʻe toe ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae kiliʻi pasia, pea ʻe ʻai ki ai hono ʻakau haʻamo.
And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

Pea tenau ʻave ʻae kofu lanumoana, ʻo ʻuʻufi ʻaki ʻae tuʻunga maama, mo hono ngaahi foʻi maama, mo hono ngaahi hikofi, mo e ngaahi tukuʻanga ʻoe maama helekosi, pea mo e ipu lolo kotoa pē, ʻaia ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki ki ai:
And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
Pea tenau tuku ia mo hono ngaahi ipu kotoa pē ke ʻuʻufi ʻaki ʻae kiliʻi pasia, pea ʻe tuku ia ki ha fata.
And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
Pea tenau faliki ʻaki ʻae feilaulauʻanga koula ʻae kofu lanumoana, pea toe ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae kiliʻi pasia, pea ʻe tuku ki ai hono ʻakau haʻamo.
And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

Pea tenau toʻo ai ʻae nāunau kotoa pē ʻoe ngāue, ʻaia ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki ʻi he faletapu, pea ʻe tuku ia ki ha kofu lanumoana, pea ʻe ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae pulonga kiliʻi pasia, pea ʻe tuku ia ki ha fata.

And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:
Pea tenau ʻave ʻae efuefu mei he feilaulauʻanga, pea ʻe ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae kofu paʻuhiʻuhi:
And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

Pea tenau tuku ki ai hono ngaahi ipu kotoa pē, ʻaia ʻoku nau ngāueʻaki ki ai, ʻio, ʻae ngaahi ipu ʻaiʻanga afi, mo e ngaahi huhu, pea mo e ngaahi huo, pea mo e ngaahi ipu luoluo, ko e ngaahi ipu kotoa pē ʻoe feilaulauʻanga; pea tenau ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae kiliʻi pasia, pea tuku ki ai hono ʻakau haʻamo.

And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.

Pea ka fakaʻosi ʻe ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha ʻae fakapulonga ʻoe faletapu, pea mo hono ngaahi nāunau kotoa pē, pea ka hiki atu ʻae ʻapitanga; ʻe toki haʻu ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate ʻo fata ia: kaeʻoua naʻa nau ala ki ha meʻa tapu, telia naʻa nau mate ai. Ko e ngaahi meʻa ni ko e kavenga ia ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.

And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

Pea ko e ngāue ʻa ʻEliesa ko e foha ʻo ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki, ko e lolo ki he maama, pea mo e meʻa namu kakala, pea mo e feilaulau meʻakai ʻoe ʻaho, pea mo e lolo ʻoe fakanofo, pea mo e pule ʻoe fale fehikitaki, pea mo e ngaahi meʻa kotoa pē ʻi ai, ʻi he faletapu, pea mo hono ngaahi nāunau ʻo ia.

And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese mo ʻElone, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
“ʻOua naʻa mo vaheʻi ʻae faʻahinga ʻoe ngaahi fānau ʻa Kohate mei he kau Livai:
Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

Ka ko eni ia te mou fai kiate kinautolu, koeʻuhi kenau moʻui, pea ʻikai mate, ʻoka nau ka haʻu ki he ngaahi meʻa toputapu: ʻe ʻalu ʻa ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha ʻo tuʻutuʻuni kiate kinautolu taki taha ʻenau ngāue mo ʻenau kavenga:
But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
Ka ʻe ʻikai tenau hū atu ke mamata ʻoka ʻuʻufi ʻae ngaahi meʻa toputapu, telia naʻa nau mate.”
But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Ke ke lau foki ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ʻo fakatatau mo ʻenau ngaahi fānau;
Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
Ke ke lau ʻakinautolu mei he tolungofulu taʻu ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nimangofulu; ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku hū ke fai ʻae ngāue, ke fai ʻae ngāue ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Pea ko e ngāue eni ʻae faʻahinga ʻoe kau Kesoni, ke tauhi, mo kavenga ʻaki:
This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

Pea tenau fua ʻae ngaahi puipui ʻoe fale fehikitaki, pea mo e fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ko hono fakapulonga, pea mo e ʻuʻufi kiliʻi pasia ʻoku ʻuʻufi ʻaki ia, pea mo e puipui ʻoe matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai,

And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

Pea mo e ngaahi puipui ʻoe lotoʻā, pea mo e puipui ke matapā ʻaki ʻi he hūʻanga ʻoe lotoʻā, ʻaia ʻoku ofi ki he fale fehikitaki pea ʻoku takatakai ʻi he veʻe feilaulauʻanga, pea mo hono ngaahi maea, pea mo e nāunau kotoa pē ʻo ʻenau tauhi, pea mo e meʻa kotoa pē kuo ngaohi maʻanautolu: ʻe pehē ʻenau tauhi.

And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

‌ʻE ʻi he tuʻutuʻuni ʻa ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha ʻae ngāue kotoa pē ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni, mo ʻenau kavenga kotoa pē, pea mo ʻenau tauhi kotoa pē: pea te mou tuʻutuʻuni kiate kinautolu ʻenau kavenga kotoa pē.

At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
Pea ko e ngāue eni ʻae faʻahinga ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai: pea ʻe puleʻi ʻenau ngāue ʻe ʻItama ko e foha ʻo ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki.
This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Pea ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Melali, ke ke lau ʻakinautolu ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ʻi he fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai;
As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
Ke ke lau ʻakinautolu mei he tolungofulu taʻu, ʻo fai hake, ʻio, ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nimangofulu, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku hū ke fai ʻae ngāue ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

Pea ko e fakahā eni ʻo ʻenau kavenga, ʻo fakatatau ki heʻenau ngāue kotoa pē ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai; ko e ngaahi laupapa ʻoe fale fehikitaki, pea mo hono ngaahi ʻakau fakamaʻu, pea mo hono ngaahi pou, pea mo hono ngaahi tuʻungaʻi pou,

And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

Pea mo e ngaahi ʻotu pou takatakai ʻoe lotoʻā, mo hono ngaahi tuʻungaʻi pou, mo hono ngaahi faʻo, mo hono ngaahi maea, fakataha mo honau nāunau kotoa pē, pea mo ʻenau ngāue kotoa pē: pea te mo lau ʻi honau hingoa ʻae ngaahi meʻa ʻoe ngāue ʻo ʻenau kavenga.

And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
Pea ko e ngāue eni ʻae fānau ʻae ngaahi foha ʻo Melali, ʻo fakatatau ki heʻenau ngāue kotoa pē ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻi he pule ʻa ʻItama ko e foha ʻo ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki.
This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Pea naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone mo e houʻeiki ʻoe kakai ʻae ngaahi foha ʻoe kau Kohate ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, pea mo e fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai,
And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
Mei he taʻu ʻe tolungofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻio, ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nimangofulu, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku hū ke fai ʻae ngāue, ki he ngāue ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai:
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
Pea ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga ko e toko ua afe mo e toko fitungeau ma nimangofulu.
And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

Ko kinautolu ni naʻe lau ʻoe fānau ʻoe kau Kohate, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku faʻa fai ʻae ngāue ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻakinautolu naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone, ʻo fakatatau ki he fekau ʻa Sihova ʻi he nima ʻo Mōsese.

These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Pea ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, pea mo e fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai,
And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
Mei he taʻu ʻe tolungofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻio, ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nimangofulu, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku hū ke fai ʻae ngāue, ki he ngāue ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai,
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
‌ʻIo, ʻakinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, mo e fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ko e toko ua afe mo e toko onongeau ma tolungofulu.
Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

Ko kinautolu ni naʻe lau ʻi he fānau ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni, ʻiate kinautolu kotoa pē ʻe ngofua ke fai ʻae ngāue ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻakinautolu naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone ʻo fakatatau ki he fekau ʻa Sihova.

These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
Pea ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻoe ngaahi fānau ʻa Melali, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, mo e fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai,
And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
Mei he taʻu ʻe tolungofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻio, ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nimangofulu, ʻakinautolu ʻoku hū ke fai ʻae ngāue, ki he ngāue ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai,
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
‌ʻIo, ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, ko e toko tolu afe ma toko uangeau.
Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
Ko kinautolu ni naʻe lau ʻi he fānau ʻoe ngaahi foha ʻo Melali, ʻa ia, naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone ʻo fakatatau ki he folofola ʻa Sihova ʻi he nima ʻa Mōsese.
These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe lau ʻi he kau Livai, ʻakinautolu naʻe lau ʻe Mōsese mo ʻElone mo e houʻeiki ʻo ʻIsileli, ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga, pea mo e fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai,
All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

Mei he taʻu ʻe tolungofulu ʻo fai hake, ʻio, ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nimangofulu, ʻakinautolu kotoa pē naʻe haʻu ke fai ʻae ngāue ʻoe fai fekau, pea mo e tauhi ʻoe kavenga ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai,
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
‌ʻIo, ko kinautolu naʻe lau ʻiate kinautolu, ko e toko valu afe, mo e toko nimangeau ma valungofulu.
Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

Pea naʻe lau ʻakinautolu ʻe he nima ʻo Mōsese, ʻo fakatatau ki he fekau ʻa Sihova, ʻo taki taha fakatatau ki heʻene ngāue, pea mo ʻene kavenga: naʻe pehē ʻa ʻene lau ʻakinautolu ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.

According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
“Ke ke fekau ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, kenau tuku kituaʻā mei he ʻapitanga ʻae kilia kotoa pē, pea mo ia kotoa pē ʻoku fānoa ai ha meʻa, pea mo ia kotoa pē ʻoku fakaʻuli ʻe he mate.
Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
‌ʻAe tangata mo e fefine ke mou tuku kituaʻā, ke mou tuku ʻakinautolu ki he tuaʻā ʻoe ʻapitanga: koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa nau fakaʻuli honau ʻapitanga, ʻaia ʻoku ou nofo ai, ʻi hono lotolotonga.”
Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
Pea naʻe fai pehē ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻonau tuku ʻakinautolu kituaʻā ʻi he ʻapitanga: ʻo hangē ko e folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, naʻe pehē ʻae fai ʻene fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.
And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Ke ke fakahā ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻOka fai ʻe ha tangata pe ʻe ha fefine ʻae angahala ʻoku fai ʻe he kakai, ke fai ha talangataʻa kia Sihova, pea halaia moʻoni ʻae tokotaha ko ia;
Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;

Tenau toki vete ʻenau angahala ʻaia kuo nau fai; pea te ne totongi ʻene angahala ʻaki ʻae meʻa ʻoku na tatau, pea ne fakalahi ki ai ʻaki ʻa hono vahe nima, pea te ne foaki ia kiate ia naʻa ne fai kovi ki ai.

Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

Pea kapau ʻoku ʻikai ha kāinga ʻoe tangata ʻoku totongi ki ai ʻae fai kovi, tuku ke ʻatu ʻae totongi ʻoe fai kovi kia Sihova, ʻio, ki he taulaʻeiki; ko e fakalahi eni ʻoe sipitangata ʻoe feilaulau fakalelei ʻaia ʻe fai ʻaki ha fakalelei koeʻuhi ko ia.

But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
Pea ko e meʻa foaki kotoa pē ʻi he ngaahi meʻa tapu kotoa pē ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻaia kuo nau ʻomi ki he taulaʻeiki, ʻe ʻaʻana ia.
And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
Pea ko e ngaahi meʻa ʻae tangata kotoa pē kuo fakatapui, ʻe ʻaʻana ia: pea ko e meʻa kotoa pē ʻe foaki ʻe ha tangata ki he taulaʻeiki ʻe ʻaʻana ia.
And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
“Ke ke fakahā ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo ke pehē kiate kinautolu, kapau ʻe afe ʻae uaifi ʻo ha tangata, ʻo fai meʻa kovi kiate ia,
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

Pea kapau ʻe mohe ha tangata mo ia, pea fakafufū ia mei he mata ʻo hono husepāniti, pea ʻoku ʻikai fakahā, pea kuo ne ʻuliʻi ai, pea ʻoku ʻikai ha taha ke tukuakiʻi ia, pea naʻe ʻikai mamata ki ai ha taha;
And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

Pea kapau ʻe tō kiate ia ʻae laumālie fakahoa, pea te ne fuaʻa ki hono uaifi, ka kuo ne ʻuliʻi: pea kapau ʻe tō kiate ia ʻae laumālie ʻoe fakahoa, pea te ne fuaʻa ki hono uaifi, ka ʻoku ʻikai ʻuliʻi ia:
And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

‌ʻE toki ʻomi ʻe he tangata hono uaifi ki he taulaʻeiki, pea te ne ʻomi ʻa ʻene feilaulau ʻaʻana, ko hono hongofulu ʻoe vahe ʻoe efa ʻoe paʻale kuo momosi; ʻe ʻikai te ne lilingi ʻae lolo ki ai, pe tuku ʻae laipeno ki ai; he ko e feilaulau eni ʻoe fuaʻa, ko e feilaulau ke fakamanatu, ke fakamanatuʻi ai ʻae angahala.

Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
Pea ʻe ʻomi ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki ke ofi, pea ʻe tuku ia ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova:
And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae vai tapu ʻi ha ipu ʻumea; pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae efu mei he faliki ʻoe fale fehikitaki, ʻo ʻai ia ki he vai.
And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

Pea ʻe tuku ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae fefine ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, pea ʻe tatala ʻae ʻulu ʻoe fefine, pea ʻe tuku ʻae feilaulau ʻoe fakamanatu ki hono nima, ʻaia ko e feilaulau ʻoe fuaʻa: pea ʻe ʻi he nima ʻoe taulaʻeiki ʻae vai kona, ʻaia ʻoku tupu ai ʻae malaʻia:

And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

Pea ʻe tuku ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki ke fuakava, ʻo ne pehē ki he fefine, “Kapau naʻe ʻikai te mo mohe mo ha tangata, pea kapau naʻe ʻikai te ke afe ke ʻuliʻi ko e mo ha taha ʻoku ʻikai ko ho husepāniti, te ke ʻataʻatā ko e mei he vai kona ni ʻoku tupu ai ʻae malaʻia:

And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
Pea kapau kuo ke afe ki ha tokotaha, ka ʻoku ʻikai ko ho husepāniti, pea kapau kuo ke ʻuliʻi koe, pea kuo mo mohe mo ha tangata ʻoku ʻikai ko ho husepāniti:
But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

(Pea ʻe toki tuku ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae fefine ke fuakava ki he malaʻia, pea ʻe pehē ʻe he taulaʻeiki ki he fefine), ʻE tuku ko e ʻe Sihova ko e malaʻia, pea mo e fuakavaʻanga ʻi ho kakai, ʻoka ngaohi ko e ʻe Sihova ke popo ho tenga, pea pupula ho kete;”

Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
Pea ko e vai ni ʻaia ʻoku tupu ai ʻae malaʻia, ʻe hū ia ki ho fatu, pea ʻe pupula ai ho kete, pea popo ai ho tenga. Pea ʻe pehē ʻe he fefine, “ʻEmeni, ʻEmeni.’
And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
Pea ʻe tohi ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae ngaahi malaʻia ni ʻi ha tohi, pea te ne holoholoʻi ia ke ʻosi ʻaki ʻae vai kona:
And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
Pea te ne tuku ʻae fefine ke ne inu ʻae vai kona, ʻaia ʻoku tupu ai ʻae malaʻia; pea ko e vai kuo tupu ai ʻae malaʻia ʻe hū kiate ia; pea toki hoko ʻo kona.
And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
Pea ʻe ʻave ʻe he taulaʻeiki mei he nima ʻoe fefine ʻae feilaulau ʻoe fuaʻa, pea te ne taʻaloʻalo ʻaki ʻae feilaulau ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, pea hili ia ki he funga feilaulauʻanga:
Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki mei he feilaulau ha falukunga, ʻio, ko hono fakamanatu ʻo ia, ʻo tutu ia ʻi he funga feilaulauʻanga, pea hili ia te ne tuku ʻae fefine ke ne inu ʻae vai.
And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

Pea ʻoka ne ka tuku ʻae fefine ke ne inu ʻae vai, ʻe hoko ʻo pehē, kapau kuo fakaʻuliʻi ia, ʻi heʻene fai meʻa kovi ki hono husepāniti, ko e vai ʻoku tupu ai ʻae malaʻia ʻe hū ia kiate ia, pea hoko ʻo kona, pea ʻe pupula hono kete, pea ʻe popo hono tenga: pea ʻe malaʻia ʻae fefine ʻi hono kakai.

And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
Pea kapau kuo ʻikai fakaʻuliʻi ia, ka ʻoku maʻa pe; ʻe toki ʻataʻatā ia, pea ʻe faʻa tuituʻia ia.
And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
Ko eni ʻae fono ʻoe fuaʻa ʻoka afe atu ʻae fefine ki ha taha kae tuku ʻa hono husepāniti, pea ʻoku ʻuli ai ia.
This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
Pea ʻoka tō ki he tangata ʻae laumālie ʻoe fakahoa, pea te ne fuaʻa ki hono uaifi, te ne tuku ʻae fefine ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, pea ʻe fai ʻe he taulaʻeiki kiate ia ʻae fono ni kotoa pē.
Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
Pea ʻe toki ʻataʻatā ʻae tangata mei he angahala, pea ʻe fua ʻe he fefine ni ʻene angahala.
Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Ke ke lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo ke pehē kiate kinautolu, ʻOka fakamāvae ia ʻe ha tangata pe ʻe ha fefine ke fuakava ʻi he fuakava ʻae fakamavahe, ke fakamāvae ʻakinautolu kia Sihova:
Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:
‌ʻE mahuʻi ia mei he uaine mo e inu mālohi, ʻe ʻikai te ne inu ʻae uaine mahi, pe ko e inu mālohi kuo mahi, ʻe ʻikai inu ʻe ia ʻae huhuʻa ʻoe kālepi, pe kai ʻae kālepi mata, pe mōmoa.
He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
‌ʻI he ʻaho kotoa pē kuo mavahe ai ia, ʻe ʻikai te ne kai ha meʻa ʻe taha kuo ngaohi mei he ʻakau ko e vaine, mei he tenga ʻo aʻu ki hono kafukafu.
All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

Ko e ʻaho kotoa pē ʻoe fuakava ʻo ʻene mahuʻi ʻe ʻikai hoko ʻae tele ki hono ʻulu: kaeʻoua ke ʻosi ʻae ngaahi ʻaho, ʻaia kuo mavahe ai ia kia Sihova, pea ʻe māʻoniʻoni ia, pea te ne tuku ke lōloa ʻa hono louʻulu.

All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
Ko e ʻaho kotoa pē kuo mavahe ai ia kia Sihova, ʻoua naʻa ofi ange ia ki ha sino kuo mate.
All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
‌ʻE ʻikai te ne fakaʻuliʻi ia koeʻuhi ko ʻene tamai, pe ko ʻene faʻē, pe ko hono tokoua, pe ko hono tuofefine, ʻoka nau ka mate: koeʻuhi ko e fakatapui ia ʻi hono ʻulu ʻe hono ʻOtua.
He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
Ko e ʻaho kotoa pē ʻo ʻene mavahe ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ai ia kia Sihova.
All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.

Pea kapau ʻe mate fakafokifā ha tangata ʻoku ofi kiate ia, pea kapau kuo ne fakaʻuliʻi ʻae fakatapu ʻo hono ʻulu; pehē te ne toki tele hono ʻulu, ʻi he ʻaho ʻo hono fakamaʻa te ne tele ia, ʻi hono ʻaho fitu.
And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
Pea ʻi hono valu ʻoe ʻaho te ne ʻomi ʻae ongo kulukulu, pe ha ongo lupe mui ki he taulaʻeiki, ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai:
And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

Pea ʻe feilaulau ʻaki ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae taha ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala, ka ko e taha ko e feilaulau tutu, pea ʻe fai ʻae fakalelei maʻana, he kuo angahala ia ʻi he mate, pea te ne fakatapui ʻa hono ʻulu ʻi he ʻaho ko ia.
And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

Pea te ne fakatapui kia Sihova ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻene mavahe, pea te ne ʻomi ʻae lami ʻi hono ʻuluaki taʻu ko e feilaulau fakalelei, ka kuo mole ʻae ngaahi muʻaki ʻaho koeʻuhi kuo fakaʻuliʻi ʻe ia ʻa ʻene mavahe.

And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
Pea ko eni ʻae fono ʻo ia kuo fakamavahe, ʻoka hili ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻene mahuʻi: ʻe ʻomi ia ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai:
And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

Pea te ne ʻatu ʻa ʻene feilaulau kia Sihova, ko e lami tangata ʻe taha taʻehanomele ʻi hono ʻuluaki taʻu, ko e feilaulau tutu, pea mo e lami fefine ʻe taha taʻehanomele ʻi hono ʻuluaki taʻu, ko e feilaulau ia maʻae angahala, pea mo e sipitangata ʻe taha taʻehanomele ko e feilaulau fakalelei ia.

And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

Pea mo e kato mā taʻefakalēvani, ʻae ngaahi foʻi mā ʻoe mahoaʻa lelei kuo fefiofi mo e lolo, pea mo e ngaahi mā manifinifi taʻefakalēvani kuo pani ʻaki ʻae lolo, mo ʻenau feilaulau meʻakai, mo ʻenau feilaulau inu.
And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
Pea ʻe ʻomi ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki ki he ʻao ʻo Sihova, pea te ne ʻatu ʻa ʻene feilaulau maʻae angahala, mo ʻene feilaulau tutu:
And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
Pea te ne ʻange ʻae sipitangata, ko e feilaulau fakalelei kia Sihova, mo e kato mā taʻefakalēvani, pea ʻe ʻatu foki ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻa ʻene feilaulau meʻakai, mo ʻene feilaulau inu.
And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

Pea ko ia kuo fakamavahe ʻe tele ʻe ia ʻa hono ʻulu ʻi heʻene mavahe ʻi he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, pea ʻe ʻave ʻe ia ʻae tuʻoni louʻulu ʻo ʻene mavahe, ʻo tuku ia ki he afi ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he lalo feilaulau fakalelei.

And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

Pea ʻe ʻave ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae alanga ʻoe sipitangata kuo haka, pea mo e foʻi mā ʻe taha taʻefakalēvani mei he kato, mo e mā manifinifi ʻe taha taʻefakalēvani, ʻo ne tuku ia ki he nima ʻo ia kuo fakamavahe, ʻoka hili ʻae tele ʻoe louʻulu ʻo ʻene mahuʻi koe.

And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

Pea ʻe lieliaki ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki, ko e feilaulau lieliaki ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova: ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ia ki he taulaʻeiki, fakataha mo e fatafata lieliaki, mo e alanga nima hiki hake; pea ka hili ia ʻe inu ʻae uaine ʻe ia naʻe fakamanavahē.
And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

“‘Pea ko eni ʻae fono ʻo ia kuo fakamavahe ʻaia kuo fuakava, pea mo ʻene feilaulau kia Sihova koeʻuhi ko ʻene mavahe, pea mo ia te ne ʻomi ʻi hono nima: ʻo fakatatau ki he fuakava naʻa ne fuakava ʻaki, ʻe pehē ʻene fai ʻo hangē ko e fono ʻo ʻene mavahe.’”

This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
“Ke ke lea kia ʻElone mo hono ngaahi foha, ʻo ke pehē, ‘ʻE pehē hoʻomou tāpuaki ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli,’ pea te mou pehē kiate kinautolu:
Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
‘Ke fakamonūʻia ko e ʻe Sihova, ʻo tauhi koe:
The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
Ke tuku ʻe Sihova ke ulo hono fofonga kiate koe, ʻo ne ʻaloʻofa kiate koe:
The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
Ke hiki hake ʻe Sihova ʻa hono fofonga kiate koe, ʻo tuku ʻae fiemālie kiate koe.’
The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
“Pea tenau tuku hoku hingoa ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; pea te u fakamonūʻia ʻakinautolu.”
And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

Pea naʻe hoko ʻo pehē ʻi he ʻaho naʻe ʻosi ai hono fokotuʻu ʻe Mōsese ʻae fale fehikitaki, pea ne luluku ia, ʻo fakatapui ia, pea mo hono nāunau kotoa pē, ʻae feilaulauʻanga, pea mo hono ngaahi ipu kotoa pē, pea ne luluku ʻo fakatapui ia;

And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
Naʻe feilaulau ai ʻae houʻeiki ʻo ʻIsileli, ko e ngaahi ʻeiki ʻoe fale ʻo ʻenau ngaahi tamai, ko e houʻeiki ʻoe ngaahi faʻahinga, pea naʻa nau pule kiate kinautolu naʻe lau:
That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

Pea naʻa nau ʻomi ʻenau feilaulau ki he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ko e saliote ʻe ono kuo fakapulonga, mo e fanga pulu ʻe hongofulu ma ua; ko e saliote ʻe taha ki he ongo ʻeiki ʻe toko ua, pea naʻa na taki taha ʻae pulu: pea naʻa nau ʻomi ia ki he matafale fehikitaki.
And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
“Ke ke maʻu ia meiate kinautolu, koeʻuhi ke fai ʻaki ia ʻae ngāue ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai; pea te ke tuku ia ki he kau Livai, ki he tangata taki taha ʻo fakatatau ki heʻene ngāue.”
Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
Pea naʻe ʻave ʻe Mōsese ʻae ngaahi saliote mo e fanga pulu, ʻo ne foaki ia ki he kau Livai.
And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
Ko e saliote ʻe ua mo e fanga pulu ʻe fā, naʻa ne foaki ki he ngaahi foha ʻo Kesoni, ʻo fakatatau ki heʻenau ngāue:
Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
Pea mo e saliote ʻe fā mo e fanga pulu ʻe valu naʻa ne foaki ki he ngaahi foha ʻo Melali, ʻo fakatatau ki heʻenau ngāue, ʻi he pule ʻa ʻItama ko e foha ʻo ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki.
And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Ka ko e ngaahi foha ʻo Kohate naʻe ʻikai te ne foaki kiate kinautolu ha taha: koeʻuhi naʻe ʻiate kinautolu ʻae tauhi ʻoe faletapu ʻi heʻenau fua ia ki honau uma.
But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
Pea naʻe pehē ʻe Sihova kia Mōsese, “ʻE ʻatu ʻe he houʻeiki ʻenau feilaulau ki he fakatapui ʻoe feilaulauʻanga, ʻo fai taki taha ʻi hono ʻaho.”
And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

Pea ko ʻene feilaulau ko e ipu siliva lahi ʻe taha, ko hono mamafa ko esikeli ʻe teau ma tolungofulu, mo e ipu siliva ʻe taha ko esikeli ʻe fitungofulu, ʻo fakatatau ki he sikeli ʻoe faletapu; naʻe fakatou pito ia ʻi he mahoaʻa lelei kuo fefiofi mo e lolo, ko e feilaulau meʻakai ia:

And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Mo e sēpuni koula ʻe taha ko esikeli ʻe hongofulu, naʻe pito ia ʻi he ʻakau namu kakala:

Mo e pulu mui ʻe taha, mo e sipitangata, mo e lami ʻe taha ʻi hono ʻuluaki taʻu, ko e feilaulau tutu ia:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Mo e ʻuhiki kosi ʻe taha ko e feilaulau ia maʻae angahala:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

Mo e pulu mui ʻe taha, mo e sipitangata, mo e lami ʻe taha ʻi hono ʻuluaki taʻu, ko e feilaulau tutu ia:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Ko e ʻuhiki kosi ʻe taha ko e feilaulau ia maʻae angahala:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

Pea ko e feilaulau ki he feilaulau fakalelei, ko e fanga pulu ʻe ua, mo e sipitangata ʻe nima, mo e kosi tangata ʻe nima, mo e lami ʻe nima ʻi honau ʻuluaki taʻu: pea ko e feilaulau eni ʻa Pakieli ko e foha ʻo ʻOkilani.
And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Pea naʻe feilaulau ʻa Heila ko e foha ʻo ʻEnani, ko e ʻeiki ʻoe fānau ʻa Nafitali ʻi hono ʻaho hongofulu ma ua:
On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:

Pea ko ʻene feilaulau ko e ipu siliva ʻe taha, ko hono mamafa ko e sikeli ʻe teau ma tolungofulu, ko e ipu siliva ʻe taha, ko e sikeli ʻe fitungofulu, ʻo fakatatau ki he sikeli ʻoe faletapu; naʻe fakatou pito ia ʻi he mahoaʻa lelei kuo fefiofi mo e lolo ko e feilaulau kai ia:

His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Mo e sēpuni koula ʻe taha ko e sikeli ʻe hongofulu, naʻe pito ia ʻi he ʻakau namu kakala:
One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
Mo e pulu mui ʻe taha, mo e sipitangata, mo e lami ʻe taha ʻi hono ʻuluaki taʻu, ko e feilaulau tutu ia:
